# `factory/server/setup.py`

[As built](../../../README.md) › [Server API and project management](../../../subsystems/server-api-and-project-management.md) › `setup.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Registers FastAPI routes for the setup screen that measure five setup stations and handle actions: starting Docker, running install commands, storing and checking API keys, building harnesses, configuring crew size, and setting rework limits.
